noWorldsYetCreateOne: No worlds yet. Create one to begin.
selectAWorldToView: Select a world to view its dossier.
invalidNameUseLettersNumbers: Invalid name: use letters, numbers, spaces, - or _.
aWorldWithThisName: A world with this name already exists.
confirmDelete: Delete world "{name}" and all of its history, NPCs and savegames? This cannot be undone.
enemyFloor: The Squishing has run for a while: roaming enemies start at level {level} here, whatever spawn mode you play on.
enemyFloorOpen: The fauna is out of hand: anything from level 1 to {level} roams the whole world.
enemyFloorCollapse: The paradox has completed: nothing below level {level} is left, and there is no upper limit at all.
storyTutorialDisabled: Story mode is written for the year 2001. Beginning in {year} disables the tutorial: the story opens straight on its own landing, with none of the scripted introduction.
earthLost: There is no Earth. Nibiru struck it on 21 December 2012 and the world map went with it: what stands in its orbit is the Omega Tower, and everything that would have taken you out onto the surface takes you there instead.

populationNotes.normal: History as it happened. Everyone is who they are and the world is populated as it was written.
populationNotes.chaos: Nothing is where it was put. Every encounter is drawn from the whole bestiary, every face in the crowd is a stranger's, every shop is stocked and priced at random, and a level up teaches whatever the world feels like teaching. What a thing is never changes: only which one you meet, and what it costs.
populationNotes.goblin: Everyone is a goblin. Only goblin faces, busts and archetypes exist, every character you build is one, and goblins are far the commonest thing roaming the map.
populationNotes.monster: Nothing human walks here. People, elves and goblins are gone from the crowd, from the wardrobe and from the fauna; the world is populated from every other archetype there is.
populationNotes.empty: Nobody is left. No people, no shopkeepers, no news, no plagues, no law and no work; history stops on 1 January 2000, property is worth nothing, and the cities are going back to green.
populationNotes.zombie: The dead got up. Nine people in ten are not people any more: where somebody would have been standing there is an undead thing instead, and it is still standing where they were.
populationNotes.death: Nobody, and nothing, is left. Everything an empty world already lacks is gone here too, and on top of it every roaming creature is gone as well: no monster, no beast, nothing waiting in a dungeon, on a procedural map or on a hand-built one alike. Whatever wildlife once stood there is silence now.

populationLocked: Chosen once, at creation: a world cannot be repopulated later.

magicalNotes.severed: Magic has been stripped from the world. Spells, enchanted items, and magical creatures no longer appear, and the MP bar is removed. The party retains only what they are given at creation.
magicalNotes.unbound: Magic runs wild across the world. Weapons are enchanted, illnesses are curses, and creatures mutate from raw ley energy. Shops and loot contain no ordinary gear.

magicalLocked: Chosen once, at creation, and independent of the timeline: any combination of the two is a world you can make.
